title: Junior Database Administrator
description: Job Information Date Opened 11/19/2026 Job Type Full time City Chennai State/Province Tamil Nadu Country India Zip/Postal Code 600096 Industry Technology Job Description Junior Database Administrator – Job Description Role purpose Perform routine database operations, health monitoring, scheduled maintenance and first-line database troubleshooting under Senior DBA technical direction. Key responsibilities Execute daily health/resource checks for SQL Server FSx clusters, standalone SQL instances, RDS PostgreSQL and MySQL estates. Monitor database space, data/log growth, storage thresholds, database status, CPU/memory indicators, connections and job/service status. Monitor routine database jobs and backup execution; validate overnight Plaza/POS backups using the agreed CHECKSUM process. Monitor S3 backup-transfer status and reconcile expected completion with source database/job status. Monitor replication status and lag dashboards; perform initial diagnostics and escalate failures to Senior DBA. Perform approved routine maintenance including index/statistics maintenance, integrity checks and job monitoring where documented. Carry out first-line troubleshooting for connection failures, common SQL errors, stored procedure/function issues and basic blocking symptoms. Collect diagnostics for deadlocks, blocking and slow queries; preserve logs, query details and timestamps. Execute approved database deployment scripts and routine configuration changes only with a change request, implementation and rollback plan. Assist with database setup/configuration, patch preparation, access reviews and routine security administration under Senior DBA approval. Participate in restore tests and DR exercises; execute assigned steps and record evidence. Maintain DBA checklists, runbooks, job schedules, backup records and shift handover documentation. Support data transfer/validation and migration tasks only when specifically assigned and approved. Required skills and experience Working SQL Server administration and practical PostgreSQL/MySQL exposure. SQL querying, basic/intermediate programming and stored procedure troubleshooting. Backup/restore, CHECKSUM, jobs, maintenance plans and recovery concepts. Locking, blocking, deadlocks, indexes, replication and performance metrics. Health monitoring, alert triage, operational reporting and documentation. Change management, runbook adherence and escalation discipline. Basic SQL, PowerShell or Python scripting. KPIs / expected outcomes Daily database checks and scheduled jobs completed with evidence. Backup and replication exceptions escalated within target. Routine DBA tickets completed accurately and on time. Maintenance/deployment tasks completed within approved windows. Complete diagnostics and handovers; low repeat incidents from missed checks. Authority and boundaries Routine tasks follow documented procedures and Senior DBA oversight. Complex tuning, production recovery decisions, schema redesign and high-risk changes are escalated. Junior DBAs do not independently approve high-risk changes, failovers, restores or access/security changes.

title: Mainframe Db2 Database Systems Engineer
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. Strong expertise in Db2 for z/OS, z/OS, database performance tuning, disaster recovery, and mainframe infrastructure management is essential. What You Will Do Administer, maintain, and support IBM Db2 for z/OS databases in large-scale enterprise mainframe environments. Install, configure, upgrade, and migrate Db2 subsystems and related tools while ensuring minimal business disruption. Monitor and optimize database performance, including buffer pools, SQL tuning, storage utilization, and workload management. Implement and manage backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and high-availability solutions to ensure business continuity. Troubleshoot and resolve complex Db2, z/OS, and application-related incidents, ensuring adherence to SLAs. Manage database security, access controls, auditing, and compliance requirements to protect sensitive enterprise data. Collaborate with application development, infrastructure, storage, and systems programming teams to support project and operational requirements. Your Future at Kyndryl At Kyndryl, your growth journey extends far beyond managing enterprise Db2 environments. As a Mainframe Db2 Database Systems Engineer, you'll have access to continuous learning opportunities, industry-recognized certifications, and hands-on experience with mission-critical technologies that power some of the world's largest enterprises. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 7+ years of experience managing IBM DB2 for z/OS in enterprise production environments, with expertise in database maintenance, monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Hands-on expertise with DB2 utilities including REORG, RUNSTATS, COPY, RECOVER, LOAD, UNLOAD, REBUILD INDEX, and CHECK DATA. Experience supporting DB2 subsystem installation, upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and version upgrades (DB2 v11/v12/v13). Strong knowledge of z/OS, JCL, TSO/ISPF, REXX, SMP/E, RACF, and Mainframe infrastructure. Experience with database performance tuning, SQL optimization, access path analysis, buffer pool tuning, and capacity planning. Expertise in backup, recovery, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity support for DB2 environments. Proficiency in monitoring and troubleshooting DB2 issues using tools such as OMEGAMON, SPUFI, QMF, BMC MainView, and DB2 Admin Tool. Experience supporting 24x7 production environments, incident resolution, problem management, and root cause analysis. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience supporting complex enterprise mainframe environments and 24x7 production services Understanding of ITIL-aligned change, release and service management practices. Experience working across system programming, application, storage and infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues Experience supporting disaster recovery exercises, audits, compliance reviews or operational governance. IBM DB2 for z/OS certification or comparable demonstrated DB2 expertise. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
